name: Tulgey Wood Breastplate
text:
This dark, withered wood armor is crafted from the tree left behind when a dryad dies. Every step in crafting is a race to seal the magic inside before the wood rots away. The result is a +1 wooden breastplate that looks to be made of eternally decaying wood. The twisted nature of your armor allows you to demoralize animals and plants without taking a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language.

Activate—Peel Bark 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You peel away a layer of dead wood. Attempt a flat check to end any persistent damage affecting your exterior (such as being on fire) as though you had an assisted recovery (DC 10 Flat check).
